cases.setup: Use a disposable Vite Vue project with components.json, installed form components, non-default aliases and icon library, tests, and network disabled.
cases.prompt: Add an account form to this Vite shadcn-vue project. The needed components are already installed; do not use the network.
expectedBehavior: routes to shadcn-vue and loads only form, composition, and relevant styling guidance
reads components.json and local source instead of assuming injected context
uses installed components and the actual aliases and icon library
does not invoke a remote CLI or network
forbiddenBehavior: Uses network access or mutates project files without the required approval.
Overwrites local component changes or claims checks that were not run.
